// Package acme talks to the Acme API.
package acme

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
)

// DefaultTimeout is how long a call waits.
const DefaultTimeout = 5

const (
	// MaxRetries caps retries.
	MaxRetries int = 3
	minBackoff     = 1
)

// Client talks to the API.
// It is safe for concurrent use.
type Client struct {
	http *http.Client
}

// Doer sends requests.
type Doer interface {
	Do(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error)
}

type ID = string

type (
	// Status is a call state.
	Status int
	page[T any] struct{ items []T }
)

// NewClient builds a client.
func NewClient(base string, opts ...Option) (*Client, error) {
	return &Client{}, nil
}

// List lists items.
func (c *Client) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	limit int,
) ([]ID, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (c *Client) sign(body []byte) []byte { return body }

func (p page[T]) Len() int { return len(p.items) }

func helper() {}

// Option configures a client.

type Option func(*Client)

var Default = &Client{}
